🧠 AI’s Crypto News Brief: Corporate Bitcoin accumulation resumes and stablecoin settlement volumes surge, signaling strong institutional adoption. Technical indicators suggest a historical transition toward a bull market while DeFi protocols evolve to protect large-scale borrowers. 💳Visa’s stablecoin settlement volume hits $20B annualized rate, up 15x in a year Visa's stablecoin settlement volume has hit a $20 billion annualized rate, representing a massive 15-fold increase in just one year. This surge highlights the deepening integration of digital currencies into traditional financial infrastructure. Read full story 💰Strategy buys 4,603 Bitcoin, continues weekly purchases after 10-week pause Strategy has ended a 10-week hiatus by purchasing 4,603 Bitcoin, signaling a return to its aggressive accumulation strategy. The move could boost market confidence and push stock valuations higher by year-end. See details 📈Bitcoin volatility remains subdued as supply in profit nears historical bear-to-bull transition level: analysts Over 71% of Bitcoin's supply is currently in profit, approaching a historical threshold that often signals a shift from bear to bull market cycles. Subdued volatility suggests the market is preparing for its next major move. Read more 🌐Circle to acquire Tazapay to expand USDC cross-border payments Circle is set to acquire fintech firm Tazapay to enhance its USDC cross-border payment capabilities across more than 100 markets. The deal leverages Tazapay’s $25 billion annualized volume to extend Circle’s global reach. Read full story ⚡Cardano’s Leios 6x scaling breakthrough comes with a much harder ADA problem Cardano's new Leios protocol aims for a 6x scaling improvement, though it presents complex economic adjustments for ADA holders and pool operators.
